description: Historical road network extracted topographic maps (series of 3 data sets) is a series of data sets listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by TRR228 Database (TRR228DB). This dataset includes a shapefile representing the digitized historical road network of Kenya. It contains over 56,000 km of historical roads extracted from 449 historical topographic maps of 1:50,000 scale and 71 maps of 1:100,000 scale covering the time period from the 1950s to the 1980s. Coverage: Kenya. The portal lists 3 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher TRR228 Database (TRR228DB). Its tags are Infrastructure, Imagery/Base Maps/Earth Cover, Road Network, Roads, Geodata. The repository dates the deposit 2024; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is [TRR228DB] Data policy agreement. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
